justification: Both depict human figures rendered in strict profile in low relief, apparently bearded and wearing tall headgear, with attention to patterned hair/beard treatment, which is the most specific correspondence. But A shows a small multi-figure scene (figures flanking an altar or emblem beneath a disc within an arched panel) above extensive fields of dense inscribed sign-rows, whereas B shows a single isolated bust-length head-and-shoulders figure filling the whole surface with no scene, no companions and no inscription.
